# Philips Sonicare Essence+ Gum Health & Airfloss Bundle

## Complete Oral Care for Healthier Gums

Give your gums the attention they deserve. This Philips Sonicare value bundle pairs the Essence+ Gum Health rechargeable toothbrush with the Airfloss rechargeable electric flosser, so you get two tools for a complete daily routine in one box.

## Gentle Gumline Care

The Essence+ brush uses Sonicare dynamic fluid action to clean between teeth and along the gumline. Compared with a manual toothbrush, it reduces plaque at the gum line, helping you maintain firmer, healthier gums. A built-in 2-minute timer keeps every brushing session on track.

## Effortless Cleaning Between Teeth

Airfloss delivers a rapid burst of air and micro-droplets to flush out plaque between teeth in about 30 seconds. It's a quick option for anyone who finds traditional floss tedious, and it reaches tight spaces, including areas around bridges, with ease.

## Designed for Everyday Comfort

Both devices feature ergonomic handles with non-slip grips, and the flosser is built to maneuver easily. Multi-voltage charging keeps them ready for daily use, and the brush offers up to 10 days of battery life between charges.

## Why Choose This Bundle

Buying the brush and flosser together saves money over purchasing them separately, and the pairing covers two steps of your oral care routine with one trusted brand.

## Start Your Healthier Routine Today

Add the Philips Sonicare Essence+ Gum Health & Airfloss Bundle to your cart and give your smile the complete care it deserves.
